title: 🏛️ Landmarks (достопримечательности) & Comparatives (степени сравнения)
description: Учимся говорить о достопримечательностях мира и сравнивать их. Мемы, факты и путешествия! 🌍

grammar.title: Landmarks — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Известные достопримечательности мира**:

🇬🇧 **Big Ben** — Биг-Бен (Лондон)
🇫🇷 **Eiffel Tower** — Эйфелева башня (Париж)
🇮🇹 **Colosseum** — Колизей (Рим)
🇪🇬 **Pyramids** — Пирамиды (Египет)
🇺🇸 **Statue of Liberty** — Статуя Свободы (Нью-Йорк)
🇦🇺 **Sydney Opera House** — Сиднейский оперный театр

🎯 **Мем**:

days.title: Day 2: Comparatives — tall, short, big, small

grammar.title: Comparatives — сравнительная степень
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как сравнивать два предмета**:

📌 **Короткие прилагательные** (1 слог) → + -er:
✅ tall → taller (выше)
✅ short → shorter (ниже)
✅ big → bigger (больше)
✅ small → smaller (меньше)

📌 **Правила правописания**:
• big → bigger (удваиваем g)
• tall → taller (просто +er)

📌 **Структура**:
✅ Big Ben is **taller** than the Colosseum.
✅ The Eiffel Tower is **shorter** than the Sydney Tower.

🎯 **Мем**:
'My homework is bigger than yours!'
'That's not how comparatives work...' 📚😅

vocabulary.example: Big Ben is tall.
The Eiffel Tower is taller than Big Ben.
The Colosseum is short.
Big Ben is shorter than the Eiffel Tower.
The Colosseum is big.
The Colosseum is bigger than Big Ben.
The Statue of Liberty is small.
Big Ben is smaller than the Eiffel Tower.

exercises.explanation: Eiffel Tower is TALLER than Big Ben! 🗼

'Shorter' means 'more short'.
Big Ben is ___ (small) than the Eiffel Tower. 🇬🇧
exercises.explanation: small → smaller! Биг-Бен меньше Эйфелевой башни! 🇬🇧

exercises.question: The Eiffel Tower is more taller than Big Ben.
exercises.correct: The Eiffel Tower is taller than Big Ben.
accept: The Eiffel Tower is taller than Big Ben
The Eiffel Tower is taller than Big Ben.

days.title: Day 3: Comparatives — old, new, famous, interesting
days.description: Учимся сравнивать достопримечательности по возрасту и известности

grammar.title: Comparatives — длинные прилагательные
grammar.rule:
📘 **Длинные прилагательные** (2+ слогов) → **more** + прилагательное:

📌 **Примеры**:
✅ famous → more famous (более известный)
✅ interesting → more interesting (более интересный)
✅ beautiful → more beautiful (более красивый)
✅ expensive → more expensive (более дорогой)

📌 **Сравнение**:
✅ Big Ben is **more famous** than the Colosseum.
✅ The Pyramids are **more interesting** than Big Ben.

🎯 **Мем**:
'Is Big Ben interesting?'
'Yes, but the Pyramids are MORE interesting!' 🏛️

vocabulary.example: The Pyramids are very old.
The Pyramids are older than the Colosseum.
The Sydney Opera House is new.
The Sydney Opera House is newer than the Colosseum.
vocabulary.context_example: Сиднейский оперный театр новее, чем Колизей.

vocabulary.example: Big Ben is very famous.
The Pyramids are more famous than the Colosseum.
The Colosseum is interesting.

'More interesting' is the comparative form of 'interesting'.
The Sydney Opera House is ___ (new) than the Colosseum. 🇦🇺
The Pyramids are more older than the Colosseum.

days.title: Day 4: Reading — Big Ben

grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:

exercises.question: What is Big Ben? 🇬🇧
exercises.explanation: Big Ben is a huge bell! Most people think it's the tower, but it's actually the bell! 🔔
exercises.readingText:
🌟 BIG BEN — LONDON'S MOST FAMOUS BELL 🌟

Most people think Big Ben is the clock tower in London. But they are wrong! Big Ben is actually the name of the huge bell inside the tower. Let's learn more about this amazing landmark!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔔 BIG BEN — THE BELL

The bell is called Big Ben. It weighs 14 tons! That's heavier than two elephants! 🐘🐘

The bell is very loud. It rings every hour. You can hear it from far away.

The name 'Big Ben' comes from Sir Benjamin Hall. He was a very big man. His nickname was 'Big Ben'!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🕰️ THE CLOCK TOWER

The tower is 96 metres tall. It's taller than the Colosseum in Rome!

Each clock face is 7 metres wide. The hour hand is 3 metres long. The minute hand is 4 metres long. That's longer than a car! 🚗

There are 334 steps to the top. That's a lot of steps! People who work there climb them every day.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💡 INTERESTING FACTS

• The tower is more than 150 years old.
• It survived World War II bombs.
• It leans a little bit! Not as much as the Leaning Tower of Pisa, but it does lean!
• It's one of the most famous landmarks in the world.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🤔 WOULD YOU CLIMB 334 STEPS?

Lots of tourists visit Big Ben every year. Some of them climb to the top. But you need to be very fit! 334 steps is not easy. Would you do it? 🏃

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

grammar.title: Comparatives — практика
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как сравнивать достопримечательности**:

📌 **Короткие слова** (+er):
✅ tall → taller, big → bigger, old → older, new → newer

📌 **Длинные слова** (more +):
✅ famous → more famous, interesting → more interesting, beautiful → more beautiful

📌 **Структура**:
✅ [A] is [comparative] than [B].

🎯 **Примеры**:
✅ The Eiffel Tower is taller than Big Ben.
✅ The Pyramids are more famous than the Colosseum.
✅ The Colosseum is older than Big Ben.

exercises.question: The Eiffel Tower is ___ than Big Ben. 🗼
The Pyramids are ___ (old) than the Colosseum. 🏛️
'More interesting' is the comparative of 'interesting'.
The Sydney Opera House is ___ (new) than the Colosseum. 🇦🇺
Big Ben is more famous than the Eiffel Tower?
exercises.correct: Is Big Ben more famous than the Eiffel Tower?
accept: Is Big Ben more famous than the Eiffel Tower
Is Big Ben more famous than the Eiffel Tower?
exercises.explanation: It's a question! 'Is Big Ben more famous than the Eiffel Tower?' 🤔

grammar.title: Повторение: сравнительные степени
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ Выбери две достопримечательности.
2️⃣ Опиши, чем они похожи.
3️⃣ Сравни их (размер, возраст, известность).
4️⃣ Напиши, какая тебе нравится больше и почему.

🎯 **Пример**:
Big Ben and the Eiffel Tower are both famous landmarks. The Eiffel Tower is taller than Big Ben, but Big Ben is older. The Eiffel Tower is more famous, but I like Big Ben more because it has a beautiful bell.

exercises.question: Big Ben and the Eiffel Tower are both ___ landmarks. (известные)
The Eiffel Tower is ___ (tall) than Big Ben. 🗼
exercises.explanation: Eiffel Tower is TALLER than Big Ben! 🗼

exercises.question: Big Ben is ___ (old) than the Eiffel Tower. 🇬🇧
exercises.explanation: Big Ben is OLDER than the Eiffel Tower! 🇬🇧

exercises.question: I like ___ more because it has a beautiful bell. (напиши достопримечательность)
